name: status-default-tier-counts-a-policy-file-that-loads-as-no-entries-node-backend
description: Plugin #192: the Node half of fixture 32. tracked.yaml holds the unquoted `- *.md` (a YAML alias), so it loads as no entries; the Node coordinator's GET /status counts it as one rejected pattern, as the Python coordinator does. Before #192 the Node coordinator reported rejected_pattern_count 0 here.
_comment: Copies fixture 09's envelope. Only policy_summary differs from 09: rejected_pattern_count is 1 and user_added_pattern_count stays 0. The rejected entry's reason never reaches the wire on either backend, so the corpus pins the count; the plugin's unit tests pin the reason text.
